retrieved_synopses: After the player sleeps with Mizora, the person they are in a romance with catches them in the morning - or Wyll catches them as default.
After meeting Karlach and choosing whether to keep her alive or kill her, Mizora appears in camp to turn Wyll into a devil or reward him with a new power.
Karlach reacts to Wyll's OM confronting her.

Right before Karlach's recruitment Wyl recognizes her as the target Mizora gave to him. It will be up to the player to avoid the confrontation with her. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xh6W54Z2kT7NfVgxgmED_3BD2sbbs62vjFxXMYfMGgc/edit?pli=1#bookmark=id.y05ljfyxmujl
context: The player slept with Mizora and Karlach — who is in the player's party and is romantically attached to them — confronts the player in camp the next morning. Karlach loathes Mizora: she works for Karlach's old mistress Zariel and has previously targeted or harmed allies like Wyll, and Karlach fears Mizora would do the same to her. Hurt and tearful, Karlach feels betrayed and says the player's actions disrespect both of them. This conversation follows recent tensions in camp over Mizora's interference and the fallout from her dealings with Wyll, which amplify Karlach's upset.
